verdict.rationale: Restate documents programmatic management surfaces. There is an Admin API (cluster state endpoint, per-service OpenAPI definitions), a CLI for managing services, deployments and invocations, and an Introspection SQL API for invocation and application state. Together these cover much of what an operator would do in a UI, but nothing in the evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, a published Admin API reference covering every UI action (e.g. journal inspection, cancel/kill), and independent hands-on confirmation of API-only operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use the CLI to interact with Restate, and manage your services, deployments and invocations.
Restate exposes information on invocations and application state via its CLI and Introspection SQL API.
